info.title: COTA API Documentation
info.description: API documentation for COTA - Smart Fish Feeding System. This API provides endpoints for managing fish pond feeding schedules, monitoring sensor data, and handling user authentication.

post.description: Register a new user account with email, password, and profile information
Authenticate user with email and password, and generate access token
Invalidate the current user authentication token

get.description: Retrieve complete history of all feed executions including scheduled and manual feeds, ordered by execution time
Get a list of all feed schedules for the authenticated user, including recent execution history
Get detailed information about a specific feed schedule including statistics and execution history

put.description: Update an existing feed schedule with new settings (all fields are optional)

delete.description: Delete an existing feed schedule permanently

post.description: Create a new automated feeding schedule with customizable frequency and time settings

patch.description: Activate a feed schedule to enable automatic feeding
Deactivate a feed schedule to disable automatic feeding

get.description: Get all currently active feed schedules for the authenticated user
Retrieve historical sensor data with advanced filtering, pagination, and aggregation options. Supports time-based queries, cursor pagination, and granularity control.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Get data from last N minutes (mutually exclusive with from/to)

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of metrics to return

304.description: Not Modified (cached data is still valid)

CreateFeedScheduleRequest.title: Create Feed Schedule Request
CreateFeedScheduleRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new feed schedule

description.example: Daily morning feeding schedule for fish pond

start_date.description: Schedule start date (optional, defaults to today)

end_date.description: Schedule end date (optional, must be after or equal to start_date)

is_active.description: Schedule active status (optional, defaults to true)

FeedScheduleListResponse.title: Feed Schedule List Response
FeedScheduleListResponse.description: Feed schedule list response with collection of items

FeedScheduleResponse.title: Feed Schedule Response
FeedScheduleResponse.description: Feed schedule response with single item

SensorHistoryResponse.title: Sensor History Response
SensorHistoryResponse.description: Sensor data history response with pagination

UpdateFeedScheduleRequest.title: Update Feed Schedule Request
UpdateFeedScheduleRequest.description: Request payload for updating an existing feed schedule (all fields are optional)
